title: when anxiety is loud

verses.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.

caption:
Anxiety gets loud. Prayer is how you answer it.

Paul does not tell us to feel less. He tells us to bring it, all of it, to God, and to bring thanks with it. The peace that comes back is not something you can explain, and it stands guard over your heart while you rest.

Philippians 4:6, 4:7 and 4:8 (BSB)
